review_candidates.description: Education: Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Engineering, Computer Science. 7-10 years of experience in information/cyber security, Minimum 3 years in security management. Proven experience managing security operations with outsourced/cloud providers and operating security technologies (PAM, WAF, IPS, firewalls, authentication, VPN); Fortinet experience is a plus. Solid experience in security risk management, incident response, secure development oversight, and fraud management in fintech, digital payments, or banking environments. Strong knowledge of regulatory and industry frameworks (Central Bank of Jordan requirements, PCI DSS, ISO 27001, data protection PDPL). Relevant certifications are strongly preferred (e.g., CISSP, CISM, CEH, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor, PCI ISA). Master's degree is a plus. Key Accountabilities: Security operations management: Manage all security operations with the cloud provider and internal teams, including security monitoring, logging, alerting, and response, ensuring effective around-the-clock protection of Orange Money platforms. Security systems management: Operate and govern all fintech security systems and parts, including PAM, WAF, IPS, firewalls, authentication systems, and VPN, ensuring proper configuration, hardening, and continuous effectiveness. Access management and approvals: Manage access approvals and privileged access governance (PAM approvals and management), enforcing least privilege, segregation of duties, periodic access reviews, and full auditability. Security risk management: Identify, assess, mitigate, monitor, and escalate security risks across all Orange Money systems, maintaining the security risk register and ensuring effective controls are implemented and independently assured. Security and Privacy by Design: Enforce Security-by-Design and Privacy-by-Design principles across all projects, changes, integrations, and new services, providing security requirements and sign-off at each stage of the delivery lifecycle. Secure coding and development security: Oversee secure coding and development practices with the Development & Source Code Manager, including secure code reviews, vulnerability scanning, penetration testing, and remediation before release. Security fraud management: Manage security fraud management capabilities, including fraud monitoring rules, detection, investigation support, and continuous tuning to protect customers and transactions. Vulnerability management, patching, and security testing: Govern vulnerability management and patching cycles with the cloud provider and vendors, and plan and coordinate penetration tests, security audits, and vulnerability assessments, ensuring timely, risk-based remediation and closure of findings. Incident response and crisis management: Lead security incident detection, containment, response, and root-cause analysis, supporting regulator and authority engagement when required, and driving sustainable remediation. Compliance and regulatory assurance: Ensure continuous compliance of security controls with Central Bank of Jordan regulations, data protection obligations, applicable group security frameworks, and industry standards (e.g., PCI DSS, ISO 27001). Third-party and integration security: Ensure the security of integrations with third parties and the national switch (JOPACC), including secure connectivity, encryption, key management, and third-party security assessments. Department objectives and performance management: Set the security department's objectives in full alignment with the directorate strategy, risk appetite, and regulatory obligations, translate them into measurable performance indicators and individual targets, and monitor, evaluate, and report achievement on a regular basis. Performance, KPIs, and SLA management: Define, monitor, and report security performance KPIs and SLAs with the cloud provider and security vendors, using measurable indicators (e.g., incident detection and response times, vulnerability remediation timelines, control effectiveness, audit findings closure), and drive corrective actions and continuous improvement of the security posture. CAPEX/OPEX and budget management: Define, plan, and manage the security department's CAPEX and OPEX budgets, including security systems, tools, licenses, and managed services, ensuring accurate forecasting, cost efficiency, budget adherence, and value realization from security investments. Security policies, standards, and awareness: Develop, maintain, and enforce security policies, standards, baselines, and procedures across Orange Money and its vendors, manage security exceptions through a formal, risk-based waiver process, and drive security awareness and training programs to strengthen the overall security culture. Threat intelligence and Group coordination: Monitor emerging threats and threat intelligence relevant to fintech and mobile money, coordinating with Operator and Group Cybersecurity teams to continuously strengthen the security posture and readiness. Team leadership and management: Lead, coach, and develop the security team, defining roles, responsibilities, and individual objectives; managing performance evaluations, workload distribution, on-call readiness, and succession planning; identifying training and certification needs in evolving security domains; and fostering a culture of vigilance, integrity, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Cross-department liaison: Act as the single point of coordination between all departments (business, products, operations, compliance, finance, customer care, etc.) and the development vendor, ensuring requirements are clearly captured, prioritized, and delivered. Requirements management: Ensure business requirements are translated into clear, complete functional and technical specifications and use cases, managing scope, timelines, and trade-offs across stakeholders. Development lifecycle governance: Establish and enforce a proper software development lifecycle (SDLC) covering analysis, design, development, testing, UAT, acceptance, and release, with defined gates and deliverables at each stage. Source code ownership and management: Ensure secure and proper source code management, guaranteeing full Orange Money ownership of the source code, including repository governance, versioning, branching strategy, access controls, code handover, and escrow arrangements where applicable. Secure coding and development: Coordinate with the Security Manager to enforce secure coding standards, code reviews, security testing (SAST/DAST), and remediation of code-level vulnerabilities before release, in line with Security-by-Design and Privacy-by-Design principles. Release coordination: Coordinate releases and deployments with the Technical Manager and the cloud provider, ensuring controlled, tested, and documented deployments with rollback plans. Quality assurance and testing: Oversee testing activities (SIT, UAT, regression, performance) and defect management, ensuring releases meet functional, security, and quality criteria before production acceptance. Department objectives and performance management: Set the development function's objectives in full alignment with the directorate strategy and business priorities, translate them into measurable performance indicators and delivery targets, and monitor, evaluate, and report achievement on a regular basis. Compliance in development: Ensure development activities comply with Central Bank of Jordan requirements, data protection obligations, and applicable group and industry standards throughout the development lifecycle. MES系统开发与优化 - 负责MES系统的需求分析、功能设计、二次开发及日常运维，深入理解生产调度、工单管理、质量追溯、物料跟踪、生产报工等核心业务流程，持续优化系统功能，提升生产数字化管理效率。 - 独立完成MES与ERP、WMS、QMS、EAP、RMS等周边业务系统的数据接口开发、对接及集成，打通系统间数据壁垒，保障跨系统数据传输的实时性、完整性与准确性。 2. 设备自动化（EAP）与数据采集 - 负责EAP系统的方案设计、落地实施与迭代优化，实现生产机台与MES系统的全自动数据交互、指令下发与状态同步。 - 熟练掌握SECS/GEM协议及E5、E30、E37等相关标准，主导设备连机调试、报文解析及通信异常排查，确保设备状态、工艺参数及生产数据的实时采集与上报。 - 熟悉Modbus TCP/RTU、OPC UA、MQTT、Profinet等工业通信协议，快速解决设备通信中断、数据延迟等现场问题，保障采集链路稳定运行。 3. 现场支持与项目落地 - 负责MES、EAP系统在车间的部署、调试、上线及员工培训，提供7×24小时运维支持，快速响应系统故障及通信异常，保障生产不间断运行。 - 编写技术设计文档、接口文档、操作手册等全套资料，配合客户审厂、评审及验收工作，确保项目顺利交付。 任职资格: 1. 学历及工作经验 - 本科及以上学历，具备4年以上制造业软件开发或系统实施经验，有完整的MES及EAP系统独立开发与落地经验者优先。 2. 开发技能 - 熟悉Java或C#，具备扎实的编程功底，能独立完成后端服务开发及接口编写，熟练掌握Spring Boot或.NET Core。 - 熟练使用SQL Server、Oracle、MySQL等数据库，精通复杂SQL编写、存储过程开发及性能调优。 3. 工业协议与自动化能力 - 熟悉SECS/GEM协议及E5、E30、E37等相关标准，具备EAP开发、设备连机调试实战经验，能独立完成设备自动化通信搭建与问题优化。 - 熟悉Modbus TCP/RTU协议，具备现场设备数据采集与故障排查能力。 - 熟悉OPC UA、MQTT、Profinet等协议，了解西门子、三菱PLC通信原理及上位机对接。 4. 综合素质 - 具备优秀的业务理解能力和跨部门沟通协调能力，能精准拆解生产一线需求并转化为技术方案。 - 具备极强的现场故障排查与问题解决能力，工作严谨负责、抗压能力强，适应工厂现场工作节奏。 5. 优先条件 - 具备半导体、面板、光伏、精密电子、AR光波导等高端制造行业实施经验者优先。 - 具备赛美特、上扬、哥瑞利、鼎捷等主流MES/EAP厂商产品开发或实施经验者优先。 - 有0到1项目经验优先

Cross-department liaison: Act as the single point of coordination between all departments (business, products, operations, compliance, finance, customer care, etc.) and the development vendor, ensuring requirements are clearly captured, prioritized, and delivered. Requirements management: Ensure business requirements are translated into clear, complete functional and technical specifications and use cases, managing scope, timelines, and trade-offs across stakeholders. Development lifecycle governance: Establish and enforce a proper software development lifecycle (SDLC) covering analysis, design, development, testing, UAT, acceptance, and release, with defined gates and deliverables at each stage. Source code ownership and management: Ensure secure and proper source code management, guaranteeing full Orange Money ownership of the source code, including repository governance, versioning, branching strategy, access controls, code handover, and escrow arrangements where applicable. Secure coding and development: Coordinate with the Security Manager to enforce secure coding standards, code reviews, security testing (SAST/DAST), and remediation of code-level vulnerabilities before release, in line with Security-by-Design and Privacy-by-Design principles. Release coordination: Coordinate releases and deployments with the Technical Manager and the cloud provider, ensuring controlled, tested, and documented deployments with rollback plans. Quality assurance and testing: Oversee testing activities (SIT, UAT, regression, performance) and defect management, ensuring releases meet functional, security, and quality criteria before production acceptance. Department objectives and performance management: Set the development function's objectives in full alignment with the directorate strategy and business priorities, translate them into measurable performance indicators and delivery targets, and monitor, evaluate, and report achievement on a regular basis. Compliance in development: Ensure development activities comply with Central Bank of Jordan requirements, data protection obligations, and applicable group and industry standards throughout the development lifecycle. MES系统开发与优化 - 负责MES系统的需求分析、功能设计、二次开发及日常运维，深入理解生产调度、工单管理、质量追溯、物料跟踪、生产报工等核心业务流程，持续优化系统功能，提升生产数字化管理效率。 - 独立完成MES与ERP、WMS、QMS、EAP、RMS等周边业务系统的数据接口开发、对接及集成，打通系统间数据壁垒，保障跨系统数据传输的实时性、完整性与准确性。 2. 设备自动化（EAP）与数据采集 - 负责EAP系统的方案设计、落地实施与迭代优化，实现生产机台与MES系统的全自动数据交互、指令下发与状态同步。 - 熟练掌握SECS/GEM协议及E5、E30、E37等相关标准，主导设备连机调试、报文解析及通信异常排查，确保设备状态、工艺参数及生产数据的实时采集与上报。 - 熟悉Modbus TCP/RTU、OPC UA、MQTT、Profinet等工业通信协议，快速解决设备通信中断、数据延迟等现场问题，保障采集链路稳定运行。 3. 现场支持与项目落地 - 负责MES、EAP系统在车间的部署、调试、上线及员工培训，提供7×24小时运维支持，快速响应系统故障及通信异常，保障生产不间断运行。 - 编写技术设计文档、接口文档、操作手册等全套资料，配合客户审厂、评审及验收工作，确保项目顺利交付。 任职资格: 1. 学历及工作经验 - 本科及以上学历，具备4年以上制造业软件开发或系统实施经验，有完整的MES及EAP系统独立开发与落地经验者优先。 2. 开发技能 - 熟悉Java或C#，具备扎实的编程功底，能独立完成后端服务开发及接口编写，熟练掌握Spring Boot或.NET Core。 - 熟练使用SQL Server、Oracle、MySQL等数据库，精通复杂SQL编写、存储过程开发及性能调优。 3. 工业协议与自动化能力 - 熟悉SECS/GEM协议及E5、E30、E37等相关标准，具备EAP开发、设备连机调试实战经验，能独立完成设备自动化通信搭建与问题优化。 - 熟悉Modbus TCP/RTU协议，具备现场设备数据采集与故障排查能力。 - 熟悉OPC UA、MQTT、Profinet等协议，了解西门子、三菱PLC通信原理及上位机对接。 4. 综合素质 - 具备优秀的业务理解能力和跨部门沟通协调能力，能精准拆解生产一线需求并转化为技术方案。 - 具备极强的现场故障排查与问题解决能力，工作严谨负责、抗压能力强，适应工厂现场工作节奏。 5. 优先条件 - 具备半导体、面板、光伏、精密电子、AR光波导等高端制造行业实施经验者优先。 - 具备赛美特、上扬、哥瑞利、鼎捷等主流MES/EAP厂商产品开发或实施经验者优先。 - 有0到1项目经验优先
